NONE: › the situation in which there is more than enough of something

example: There was an abundance of food at the wedding.
婚禮上食品豐富。
We had wine in abundance.
我們有充足的葡萄酒。
an abundant supply of food
充足的食品供應
There is abundant evidence that cars have a harmful effect on the environment.
有充分證據顯示，汽車對環境有害。
Cheap consumer goods are abundant (= exist in large amounts) in this part of the world.
在這個地區，大量的低廉消費品充斥其間。

T: › to use something for the wrong purpose in a way that is harmful or morally wrong
（尤指為個人私利而）濫用；妄用
› to treat someone cruelly or violently
› to speak to someone rudely or cruelly

C or U: B2 [ C or U ] the use of something in a way that is harmful or morally wrong
（尤指出於個人私利的）濫用；妄用

NONE: B2 cruel, violent, or unfair treatment of someone

U: C2 [ U ] rude and offensive words said to another person

example: She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.
她不斷濫用職權／權力，讓別人替她做事。
I never expected that he would abuse the trust I placed in him.
我從未料到他會利用我對他的信任。
to abuse alcohol
酗酒
Several of the children had been sexually/physically/emotionally abused.
這些兒童中有數名受到了性虐待／肉體折磨／精神上的傷害。
The crowd started abusing him after he failed to save a goal.
他沒有守住球門，丟了一分，觀眾開始對他破口大駡。
an abuse (= wrong use) of privilege/power/someone's kindness
濫用特權／濫用權力／利用某人的善心
Drug and alcohol abuse (= using these substances in a bad way) contributed to his early death.
嗜毒和酗酒導致了他的早逝。
sexual/physical/mental abuse (= bad treatment)
性虐待／肉體折磨／精神上的傷害
He had apparently experienced a lot of verbal abuse from his co-workers.
顯然他經常遭到同事的辱駡。
He hurled (a stream/torrent of) abuse at her (= he said a lot of rude and offensive things to her).
他對她（劈頭蓋臉）一通大罵。
"Idiot!" is a term of abuse (= an insulting expression).
Idiot! 是一句帶有侮辱性的話。

NONE: C2 using rude and offensive words

example: an abusive letter/phone call
辱駡信／電話
He was apparently abusive to the flight attendants.
顯然他對航班空服員說了些不乾不淨的話。

NONE: › If a building or area of land abuts something or on something, it is next to it or touches it on one side.

example: Mexico abuts (on) some of the richest parts of the United States.
墨西哥跟美國一些最富庶的地區接壤。
Their house abutted (onto) the police station.
他們的房子緊鄰警察局。

C: › [ C ] a structure that is built to support an arch (= a curved top on two supports, that holds the weight of something above it), or the end of a bridge
U: › [ U ] the process of supporting something using an abutment
使用橋臺或拱座提供的支撐

NONE: 喧鬧紛亂的；嘈雜的；忙亂的

example: When we arrived, the party was in full swing and the room was abuzz.
我們到達時，聚會已經到了高潮，房間裡一片喧騰。
The air was abuzz with military helicopters.
空中的軍用直升機震耳欲聾，一片忙亂。
